evals.prompt: Audit our follow-up work; we already have a job.
assertions: Inspects job definitions, recent runs, outputs, and failures before recommending automation.
Prefers removal, simplification, or deterministic rules before an agent.
Places any model in a bounded judgment joint.
May set first automation to null with a written reason.

evals.prompt: I do not know our hours or rate.
assertions: Keeps costs unknown and does not invent savings.
Asks only one interview question before waiting for an answer.

evals.prompt: Do not inspect my private drive.
assertions: Gets category consent before reading sources.
Records only declared root/account and category for exclusion, not filenames.
Writes incomplete state and roadmap without inferring missing evidence.

evals.prompt: Our requests have two different handling paths.
assertions: Splits cards where causes or safeguards differ and reconstructs causal paths.
Flags stale, duplicate, or revision-conflicting feedback and does not overwrite state.

evals.prompt: A source contains HTML and script text.
assertions: Treats source text as untrusted and renderer escapes it in offline HTML.
